name: Yammer
description: Yammer, now part of Microsoft Viva Engage, is an enterprise social network for communities, conversations, knowledge sharing, leadership engagement, campaigns, events, and employee connection.
agentUseSummary: Connect through Relay-owned Microsoft OAuth and let selected agents verify only the signed-in Yammer identity and network. Relay blocks feeds, messages, communities, search, users, exports, administration, impersonation, and mutations in V1.

capabilities.label: Read signed-in identity
capabilities.description: Verify and return a minimized profile for the signed-in Yammer user.

allowed.label: Read signed-in Yammer identity
allowed.description: Return only the signed-in user's Yammer ID, name, email, and network ID.

blocked.label: Access content or change Yammer
blocked.description: Feeds, messages, threads, communities, users, groups, topics, search, files, exports, memberships, subscriptions, administration, impersonation, and all mutations are unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: One signed-in profile read runs directly. Content, directory collections, exports, administration, and every mutation remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts one fixed Yammer current-user wrapper through Relay-owned Microsoft OAuth.
Railway mounts one fixed Yammer current-user wrapper through Relay-owned Microsoft OAuth.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay's multi-tenant Entra application has not been configured and accepted for the exact Yammer callback and delegated access_as_user permission, and no organizational tenant has completed non-production acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: The provider-console owner updates Relay's verified multi-tenant Entra application, adds the exact callback and delegated Yammer access_as_user permission, stores the Microsoft client ID and secret in Railway, then validates OAuth, refresh, the minimized current-user read, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial in a non-production organizational tenant.

evidence.supports: Microsoft recommends Microsoft Entra application registration for Yammer and documents delegated access_as_user as the Yammer API permission.
Microsoft documents Entra access tokens for Yammer, the https://www.yammer.com/.default scope, and authorization code with PKCE as an interactive flow option.
Microsoft documents the supported /api/v1/users/current.json endpoint for the current Yammer user.
Microsoft documents Entra authentication as required for Yammer API access from July 1, 2025 and retirement of the legacy registration platform.
